inputs.name: hand over from Model Registry to CI/CD Pipeline

output.level_0: Registry exports fail silently, leaving the pipeline with stale model artifacts and no clear error trace.
output.level_1: No defined handoff exists, so developers copy model files manually without any version tracking or metadata.
output.level_2: Engineers manually download models from the registry and upload them to the pipeline storage each time.
output.level_3: The pipeline automatically pulls the latest approved model version from the registry during every build.
output.level_4: Handoffs enforce compliance checks, ensuring only signed and audited models trigger the deployment pipeline.
